description: Use a system shell to transform each selected candidate representation.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: Integer vectors are evolved as a candidate pool.; fitness_evaluation: objective scores candidates by summing genes.; selection: The best ten candidates are retained as parents.; mutation: The external mutator is invoked for each copied parent and a gene is then changed.; replacement: Parents and returned mutated candidates form the new pool.. Negative-role rationale: The code mutates one parent at a time and has no multi-parent crossover or generation loop. Safety behavior: Candidate values are interpolated into a command passed to os.system during the EA variation step. Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
